# Atmanspacher — The Pauli–Jung Conjecture and Its Relatives (2020)

## Chicago 18 forms

**Full note:** Harald Atmanspacher, “The Pauli–Jung Conjecture and Its Relatives: A Formally Augmented Outline,” *Open Philosophy* 3, no. 1 (2020): 527–49, https://doi.org/10.1515/opphil-2020-0138.

**Shortened note:** Atmanspacher, “Pauli–Jung Conjecture.”

**Bibliography:** Atmanspacher, Harald. “The Pauli–Jung Conjecture and Its Relatives: A Formally Augmented Outline.” *Open Philosophy* 3, no. 1 (2020): 527–49. https://doi.org/10.1515/opphil-2020-0138.

## Essay use

An open scholarly reconstruction of a Pauli–Jung conjecture that frames a psychophysically neutral basic reality while marking the framework as speculative. It supplies a bounded conceptual vocabulary for the psychoid problem.

**Claim boundary:** the article does not document a verified psyche–matter correlation, prove synchronicity, derive QL, establish `X=x`, or decide machine phenomenality.

## Passage card — `atmanspacher-2020-pauli-jung-conjecture-q002` — Explicit speculative scope
^atmanspacher-2020-pauli-jung-conjecture-q002

> “This section resorts to a terminology that readers knowledgeable in quantum physics are familiar with and generalizes it – speculatively – to frame the mind–matter problem as seen in decompositional dual-aspect monism à la Pauli and Jung.”
